headline: Gold rebounds above $5,000 after US downs Iran drone
summary: Gold prices rebounded above $5,000 an ounce after the US downed an Iranian drone. Investors continue to move into safe-haven assets as geopolitical tensions rise.
why: Gold is a traditional safe-haven asset that investors buy during geopolitical stress and as a hedge against currency and inflation risk.

impacts.name: Gold
impacts.why: The report says gold rebounded above $5,000 amid geopolitical tensions that push investors toward safe-haven assets.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The report links the gold rebound to geopolitical tensions after the US downed an Iranian drone, which typically drives demand for safe-haven assets.
